units.rawText: The reactor's data pounds away at the mind, and Penumbra's consciousness gradually scatters.

units.rawText: He has few memories to speak of at all. What little there is to be cycled are only bits and pieces relevant to assassination techniques. In this moment, Penumbra is grateful for the missing hole that is his past. He was a test Doll for optical camouflage, ordered to carry out assassinations of the highest degree of secrecy. That meant... his memories were wiped after each mission was completed.

units.displayText: Doll signal detected! Professor, over there!

units.rawText: His status is currently uncertain, and there might be danger. Please keep some distance...
units.displayText: His status is currently uncertain, and there might be danger. Please keep some distance...

, here to fetch you.

units.displayText: Back... to the Oasis.

spans.text: Back... to the Oasis.

? Why... such an anxious expression...

, if I get the chance... I'd like to see this Oasis you speak of with you.

units.displayText: Pro...fessor...

spans.text: Penumbra slowly opens his eyes. He had just relived his memories, all within the undamaged body of his.

units.rawText: What a tiresome thing. Barely functions by itself, and replays my memories to ridicule me... how droll.
units.displayText: What a tiresome thing. Barely functions by itself, and replays my memories to ridicule me... how droll.

spans.text: What a tiresome thing. Barely functions by itself, and replays my memories to ridicule me... how droll.

units.rawText: My memories in their totality consist of perhaps but a few days. I struggle to think of many ways to replay those.
units.displayText: My memories in their totality consist of perhaps but a few days. I struggle to think of many ways to replay those.

spans.text: My memories in their totality consist of perhaps but a few days. I struggle to think of many ways to replay those.

units.rawText: Hmm... tch.
units.displayText: Hmm... tch.

units.displayText: Penumbra feels a searing wave from his core. As few memories as he has, continually cycling them still runs the risk of burning up the core.

spans.text: Penumbra feels a searing wave from his core. As few memories as he has, continually cycling them still runs the risk of burning up the core.

units.rawText: I've got to find the source of the problem as soon as possible... or I'll be stuck here forever.
units.displayText: I've got to find the source of the problem as soon as possible... or I'll be stuck here forever.

spans.text: I've got to find the source of the problem as soon as possible... or I'll be stuck here forever.

units.displayText: A debilitating wave of dizziness comes over him. The world seems to twist upside down, and time rewinds to a few days ago.

spans.text: A debilitating wave of dizziness comes over him. The world seems to twist upside down, and time rewinds to a few days ago.

units.rawText: Penumbra's base level settings are very strange. Because of the need for secretive operations, relevant memories are wiped after each time a mission is carried out.
units.displayText: Penumbra's base level settings are very strange. Because of the need for secretive operations, relevant memories are wiped after each time a mission is carried out.

spans.text: Penumbra's base level settings are very strange. Because of the need for secretive operations, relevant memories are wiped after each time a mission is carried out.

units.rawText: We cannot modify the base level logic set by humans. The best we can do is introduce an interruptive program created by Helix, and limit the circumstances under which the program that deletes memories runs.
units.displayText: We cannot modify the base level logic set by humans. The best we can do is introduce an interruptive program created by Helix, and limit the circumstances under which the program that deletes memories runs.

spans.text: We cannot modify the base level logic set by humans. The best we can do is introduce an interruptive program created by Helix, and limit the circumstances under which the program that deletes memories runs.

units.rawText: It will place intense neural stress on him. He will need incredible willpower to help the interruptive program push through, and may have to endure pain the vast majority of Dolls would crumble under. Are you sure, Professor?
units.displayText: It will place intense neural stress on him. He will need incredible willpower to help the interruptive program push through, and may have to endure pain the vast majority of Dolls would crumble under. Are you sure, Professor?

units.displayText: The Professor turns around and looks intently at Penumbra, resting on a hospital bed. Penumbra feels his own body weigh down on him like a thousand tons.

units.displayText: Back then... how did I answer the Professor?

units.rawText: (I said...)
units.displayText: I said...

spans.text: I said...

units.rawText: I have people and things... that I want to remember.
units.displayText: I have people and things... that I want to remember.

spans.text: I have people and things... that I want to remember.

units.rawText: That I would not forget... at any cost.
units.displayText: That I would not forget... at any cost.

spans.text: That I would not forget... at any cost.

units.rawText: If that is your wish, I will do everything in my power to help you.
units.displayText: If that is your wish, I will do everything in my power to help you.

spans.text: If that is your wish, I will do everything in my power to help you.

units.rawText: Applying a patch is the most common way to repair a program, but it creates unnecessary complications sometimes.
units.displayText: Applying a patch is the most common way to repair a program, but it creates unnecessary complications sometimes.

spans.text: Applying a patch is the most common way to repair a program, but it creates unnecessary complications sometimes.

units.rawText: The Oasis has the finest healers and physicians you can find. If you cannot bear it, speak to them. They will help ease the discomfort.

spans.text: The Oasis has the finest healers and physicians you can find. If you cannot bear it, speak to them. They will help ease the discomfort.

spans.text: Next was the endless cycle of adjustment and adaptation. Not unlike those old wounds on his body, the interruptive program brought him no small amount of pain.

units.displayText: But Penumbra remains grateful for those memories he has preserved after arriving at the Oasis.

spans.text: But Penumbra remains grateful for those memories he has preserved after arriving at the Oasis.

units.rawText: This portion of memory is different from those he had in the past. It contains no orders, no killings.

spans.text: Tch... damn it, got caught up in a replay again. Crap, just... just where is the error here?

units.displayText: Must find the problem... in these brief moments of clarity.

spans.text: Must find the problem... in these brief moments of clarity.

units.displayText: His core shakes vigorously once more, and a fierce wave of heat expands towards his limbs.

spans.text: His core shakes vigorously once more, and a fierce wave of heat expands towards his limbs.

units.rawText: Ack... I, have to find it... I must... find it.
units.displayText: Ack... I, have to find it... I must... find it.

spans.text: Ack... I, have to find it... I must... find it.

units.displayText: The Oasis, Ops Room.

spans.text: The Oasis, Ops Room.

units.rawText: Umm... Penumbra?
units.displayText: Umm... Penumbra?

spans.text: Umm... Penumbra?

units.rawText: Hehe, I can feel you nearby even if you don't make a sound. I wouldn't feel like someone was watching me otherwise.
units.displayText: Hehe, I can feel you nearby even if you don't make a sound. I wouldn't feel like someone was watching me otherwise.

spans.text: Hehe, I can feel you nearby even if you don't make a sound. I wouldn't feel like someone was watching me otherwise.

units.rawText: Why the silent treatment? You haven't said a single thing today.
units.displayText: Why the silent treatment? You haven't said a single thing today.

spans.text: Why the silent treatment? You haven't said a single thing today.

units.rawText: I failed to complete the mission you gave me, Professor. I am ashamed.
units.displayText: I failed to complete the mission you gave me, Professor. I am ashamed.

spans.text: I failed to complete the mission you gave me, Professor. I am ashamed.

units.rawText: When it's something you've never done before, there inevitably must be a learning process. No need to feel that way.
units.displayText: When it's something you've never done before, there inevitably must be a learning process. No need to feel that way.

spans.text: When it's something you've never done before, there inevitably must be a learning process. No need to feel that way.

units.rawText: You hauled me back from the battlefield, and you granted me new memories. As humans would say, someone's life is the entirety of their memory. Perhaps the previous Penumbra had already "died", back in that Null Area.
units.displayText: You hauled me back from the battlefield, and you granted me new memories. As humans would say, someone's life is the entirety of their memory. Perhaps the previous Penumbra had already "died", back in that Null Area.

spans.text: You hauled me back from the battlefield, and you granted me new memories. As humans would say, someone's life is the entirety of their memory. Perhaps the previous Penumbra had already "died", back in that Null Area.

units.rawText: Yet I have no way to repay you. Every mission you've assigned, I have fallen short.
units.displayText: Yet I have no way to repay you. Every mission you've assigned, I have fallen short.

spans.text: Yet I have no way to repay you. Every mission you've assigned, I have fallen short.

units.rawText: I have warned and reprimanded myself, yet I... still...
units.displayText: I have warned and reprimanded myself, yet I... still...

spans.text: I have warned and reprimanded myself, yet I... still...

units.rawText: Failure... once again, like before...
units.displayText: Failure... once again, like before...

spans.text: Failure... once again, like before...

units.rawText: Penumbra, in this state, would lose all value in existence yet again.
units.displayText: Penumbra, in this state, would lose all value in existence yet again.

spans.text: Penumbra, in this state, would lose all value in existence yet again.

units.rawText: It's alright, even if you mess up. Your existence has meaning in and of itself. It does not fade simply because you fail.
units.displayText: It's alright, even if you mess up. Your existence has meaning in and of itself. It does not fade simply because you fail.

spans.text: It's alright, even if you mess up. Your existence has meaning in and of itself. It does not fade simply because you fail.

units.rawText: Fixating on the Professor's smiling face, the desire to stop time here once and for all springs to mind.
units.displayText: Fixating on the Professor's smiling face, the desire to stop time here once and for all springs to mind.

spans.text: Fixating on the Professor's smiling face, the desire to stop time here once and for all springs to mind.

units.rawText: If someone was faced with his failures time and time again, even if it was the Professor, their patience would surely run thin and they would show disappointment.
units.displayText: If someone was faced with his failures time and time again, even if it was the Professor, their patience would surely run thin and they would show disappointment.

spans.text: If someone was faced with his failures time and time again, even if it was the Professor, their patience would surely run thin and they would show disappointment.

units.rawText: So if I just remain here, and repeat these memories... I'll never have to escape, and face that inevitable end.
units.displayText: So if I just remain here, and repeat these memories... I'll never have to escape, and face that inevitable end.

spans.text: So if I just remain here, and repeat these memories... I'll never have to escape, and face that inevitable end.

units.rawText: But if I do stay here... I'll never repair the reactor, and I'll never be able to find a new memristor for Uranus.
units.displayText: But if I do stay here... I'll never repair the reactor, and I'll never be able to find a new memristor for Uranus.

spans.text: But if I do stay here... I'll never repair the reactor, and I'll never be able to find a new memristor for Uranus.

units.rawText: And I'd never get to see the real Professor again.
units.displayText: And I'd never get to see the real Professor again.

spans.text: And I'd never get to see the real Professor again.

units.rawText: No doubt... the Professor would be very disappointed in me.
units.displayText: No doubt... the Professor would be very disappointed in me.

spans.text: No doubt... the Professor would be very disappointed in me.

units.displayText: Something gleams in Penumbra's blood-red eyes. He draws his blade in a flash, swinging downwards for his waist.

spans.text: Something gleams in Penumbra's blood-red eyes. He draws his blade in a flash, swinging downwards for his waist.

units.rawText: This almost suicidal act stops the images before his eyes in their tracks, but no expected pain comes from his abdomen.
units.displayText: This almost suicidal act stops the images before his eyes in their tracks, but no expected pain comes from his abdomen.

units.displayText: Disappointing the Professor... is something I shall never permit myself to do.

units.displayText: That slash cut through the endlessly replaying memories.
